name: netguard-v2-dev
description: Run frontend, backend, and probe concurrently

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:probe"
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && python app.py
scripts.start:probe: cd probe && pip install -r requirements.txt && python probe.py

author: Md Abdur Rahman Fahad
